Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that R. B. Bennett was the Prime Minister of Canada when the Toronto Maple Leafs first won the Stanley Cup. The Predicted Answer claims it was Sir Robert Borden, specifically in 1918. Upon historical review, the Toronto Maple Leafs, under their current name, first won the Stanley Cup in 1932, at which time R. B. Bennett was Prime Minister. However, the franchise (then called the Toronto Arenas) first won in 1918, when Sir Robert Borden was Prime Minister. The Ground Truth Answer appears to be referencing the first Maple Leafs (not Arenas) win, while the Predicted Answer references the first franchise win in 1918. The Ground Truth Answer (R. B. Bennett) is NOT present in the Predicted Answer, which specifically mentions Sir Robert Borden.

Decision: FALSE
